customManagers.description: ARG <NAME>_VERSION pinned in agents/*/Dockerfile and Dockerfile.windows, annotated with '# renovate: datasource=... depName=... [versioning=...] [extractVersion=...]'; an optional ARG <NAME>_COMMIT on the next line holds the digest. The checksums next to a Windows tool version (GIT_SHA256, PYTHON_SHA256) are updated by hand.

packageRules.description: The base image is built locally by the launchers, not pulled.
Stay on the node 24 LTS line (the Linux image and the Windows zip alike); only its digest and minor releases move.
hermes also has old date-style tags (v2026.9.24) and canary tags; only vX.Y.Z releases count.
